---

**What's the asset idea?**
A clear description of what you'd like to see made.

**Why would it be useful?**
What kind of project/scene would this fit into? Helps prioritize.

**Note:** suggestions are genuinely read, but not guaranteed — new assets are made on my own schedule and creative direction. If it fits, it might show up in a future weekly drop!

Supporters of the project can request a model directly instead: see [Request a Model](https://skywolfgamestudios.github.io/CC0Tree/#request).
